title: Chapter 19 Ruthless
content:
Chapter 19 Ruthless

With the slow pressure of those troops, Denell was like a trapped beast, with red eyes and desperately waving the weapon in his hand.

In an instant, the surrounding blood flowed into a river, and the broken arm and stump were scattered all over the ground. People rushed up and lay down, everyone lost their minds, and there was only one thought in their hearts, that is to kill the man in front of them.

The lucidity lost in their minds, and the only thing left is brutality and killing to ease the anger in their hearts.

Since their defeat, they have become slaves in a prison camp, and the repression in their hearts has continued to torture them. Let them suffer every day.

I don't know when I will die, maybe for an unknown reason, maybe it's a dissatisfaction with the Yellow Turbans, maybe it's a decision of the superior, and my life may be lost at any time. These precarious days filled their hearts with torture all the time.

Denier laboriously chopped down a servant army again. His hands were as heavy as a thousand pieces, and it was a little hard to lift them up, as if they would not be able to lift them next time.

But the obsession in his heart supported his body, allowing his body to gain strength again and again, constantly recalling his own little vitality.

The joy of the Yellow Turbans did not last long. Soon those servants and slaves were exhausted. When they got on, the eight Yellow Turbans looked at each other. Their loyalty to Zhong Yu finally defeated their favorite fears. With a loud roar, he rushed up and fought with Denell?

Finally, with the fall of the last enemy, there was no one left in front of Denier, and all the people were already lying at his feet.

Twenty-three people, a total of twenty-three people, and now there are twenty-three dead souls in Denier's hands. But he has no strength now, and his body is overdrawn and is about to collapse.

His face was so white that there was no trace of blood, a blue mark appeared on his face, and his body was trembling, but his eyes were full of determination.

With a strong will, he slowly walked towards the high platform where Zhong Yu was. The steps were slow, but full of firmness.

Zhong Yu quietly watched the man walking towards his position, with no expression on his face, just looked at him so calmly.

Finally, Denell has got on the high stage. Behind them, all the soldiers of the Alliance Army looked at him with anticipation.

Their leader had already reached the commander-in-chief of the enemy soldier. It seemed that as long as he gently raised the knife in his hand and slashed at the man in front of him, victory in this war would be within reach.

Denell seemed to think so too, laboriously raised the arm in his hand, slowly towards it, and raised it above his head. It stopped and seemed to be accumulating power, enough to give the enemy a fatal blow.

The soldiers under Zhong Yu were all looking at this side with despair, their commander-in-chief, the terrifying and awe-inspiring lord. Is the man who gave them food, shelter, and even a wife about to perish? I can't believe it!

However, something unexpected happened. I saw that Zhong Yu had brought out the sword in his hands in advance before Denier's weapon was split.

The sword light flashed past, and a white light waved out, and Denell's face full of determination flew up with his head. His expression was even full of disbelief, how could he possibly lose? Was his head taken off by others so easily?

There was a sneer at the corner of Zhong Yu's mouth, and he couldn't help but think to himself: Humph, you still want to fight with me like this? I asked the system long before you came to the high platform. Now your blood is almost drained, your physical strength is exhausted, your entire muscles are collapsed and strained, and your body may turn into a pool of rotten flesh at any time. I still want to use the power of killing more than 20 people before to scare myself and let myself be caught obediently, how is it possible!

No matter how many people you kill, you can't scare yourself and let yourself obey your decision obediently. I am serious about my life, but I care unexpectedly. Even if you kill all my troops, I won't just obediently capture them.

If I hadn't asked the system, I would have been frightened by you! But fortunately there is a system, otherwise I might give up all the troops and flee directly back to the territory, and then gather those cannon fodder to defend the territory to the death.

If the people are gone, you can recruit again. If the territory is gone, you can build it again, but if your own life is gone, then there is nothing left. If you have a system in your body, the world is so big, where can you not go? Why should you lose your own life for the lives of a few unrelated people! Zhong Yu's heart is so indifferent to other people's lives.

I want myself, like the virgin bitch in those brain-dead novels in my previous life, casually giving my life to save a stranger. Or for their subordinates, friends, and never flinch in the face of the enemy. Then it can only be hehe!

The son of a thousand gold does not sit in the hall, and the gentleman does not stand under a dangerous wall. This is summed up by the ancients. And what kind of white dragon fish suit is playing, putting yourself in danger, putting yourself in a dangerous place, representing a country, and ignoring all the people, just for the sake of a few irrelevant people, and giving up the whole world People, civil and military officials, that is the real indifference and inhumanity.

As a high-ranking person, you only need to consider how to use people and who to use. And ensure your own absolute safety, then, as long as you don't act obediently and don't play anything out of the ordinary, all the dangers will be borne and solved by your own subordinates.

In this way, the country can be stable, and the country cannot live without a ruler for a day, that's how it came.

The thing that made Zhong Yu the most ridiculous in his previous life was that it was really ridiculous that the emperor went to privately visit the people in private, and only some ignorant and ignorant people would believe such a lie that could be broken at once.

As an emperor, you left the palace that represented the emperor's majesty and authority. For a long time, he did not communicate with his ministers, and he did not meet with his root, the servants in the palace. Wouldn't those ministers and their concubines be suspicious? The emperor is missing? Who did it? How is his safety?

It’s nothing for a day or two. After a long time, those ambitious people will emerge, princes, clans, and even some rebels from all over the world, and the country will instantly fall into a turbulent situation. , In this case, who dares to play private interviews with micro-servers?

I didn't see Qin Shi Huang inspecting the six kingdoms in Shandong, Emperor Yang of Sui went south to Jiangdu, and Qianlong visited Jiangnan six times. Are they all accompanied by an army of hundreds of thousands of people to escort them? Who dares to go out with one or two people? Don't you know there are many people staring at the throne under your ass?

With Denell's death, the barbarian coalition's excitement at first dropped to despair in an instant. In a short period of time, two emotions went up and down one after another, and they were already a little tired, and they were instantly exhausted.

The morale dropped all of a sudden, and some people even began to give up on themselves and let the enemy on the opposite side kill them. Or throw down the weapon and flee back quickly, ignoring the enemy behind him. Abandoned his dignity, abandoned his companions, abandoned his past glory, abandoned everything he could abandon, except life.

Only Anderson organized some people, about thirty or so, to resist reluctantly, but those were the people Anderson reluctantly summoned based on his previous prestige.

Once there is something in the hearts of those people, more than the loyalty that his prestige and kindness maintain. Then it will be the last one that crushes the camel, causing the total collapse of the army, becoming a horse in the desert, running everywhere.

Zhong Yu - I don't care about the flood after I die.
